| turbot/steampipe | [#5071](https://github.com/turbot/steampipe/pull/5071) | Stop one bad config file from freezing connection syncing: `loadConfig` failed the whole load on any malformed `.spc` file, undecodable block, or duplicated plugin or options block, so the connection watcher never reached `RefreshConnections`; each file is now parsed on its own and dropped with a warning, block failures skip just that block, and the load still errors when nothing else defines config so existing schemas are kept, fixing #5039, with regression tests on the loader and the watcher path | 🔵 Review |
| nginx/nginx-prometheus-exporter | [#1371](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-prometheus-exporter/pull/1371) | Stop one missing unix socket from marking every scrape target down: collectors shared a single `http.Transport` and `registerCollector` overwrote its `DialContext` for each unix socket target, so all collectors dialed the last socket and `nginx_up` went to 0 everywhere; each collector now gets its own cloned transport, fixing #1358, and a regression test covers it | 🔵 Review |
| clastix/kamaji | [#1373](https://github.com/clastix/kamaji/pull/1373) | Stop a PostgreSQL database switch from retargeting the root connection: the switch closure in `internal/datastore/postgresql.go` now copies `*pg.Options` before setting `Database` instead of writing through the shared pointer, so a root-pool redial no longer lands in the tenant database and makes `DeleteDB`'s `DROP DATABASE` fail with `55006`; a regression test covers it | 🔵 Review |
| gogf/gf | [#4927](https://github.com/gogf/gf/pull/4927) | Fix a data race when two servers register routes and start in different goroutines: the package-level `preBindItems` slice in `net/ghttp/ghttp_server_router_group.go` is now guarded by a mutex, with routes bound outside the lock, and `Test_Issue4128` fails under `-race` without the fix | 🔵 Review |
| OT-CONTAINER-KIT/redis-operator | [#1945](https://github.com/OT-CONTAINER-KIT/redis-operator/pull/1945) | Stop the RedisReplication embedded sentinel Service and StatefulSet from being updated on every reconcile: the common reconcilers in `internal/controller/common/{service,statefulset}` now compare with the k8s-objectmatcher three-way patch and a last-applied annotation, as `internal/k8sutils` already does, instead of `equality.Semantic.DeepEqual`, so API-server defaults no longer count as drift while changed and removed fields are still applied | 🔵 Review |
| gogf/gf | [#4926](https://github.com/gogf/gf/pull/4926) | Fix `TransactionWithOptions` failing with "unsupported propagation behavior" when `TxOptions.Propagation` is left empty: `database/gdb/gdb_core_transaction.go` now falls back to `DefaultTxOptions` (`PropagationNested`) the way `Transaction` does, so a caller can set only `ReadOnly` or `Isolation`, and the sqlite and sqlitecgo tests that pinned the old error are updated | 🔵 Review |
| ccfos/nightingale | [#3437](https://github.com/ccfos/nightingale/pull/3437) | Fix script notify channels receiving a literal `\n` instead of line breaks: `RenderEventForChannel` in `models/message_tpl.go` now renders plain text for the script, wecomapp, feishuapp and smtp channels, whose providers encode the message themselves, while HTTP channels keep the JSON escaping their request bodies need | 🔵 Review |
| elastic/beats | [#53857](https://github.com/elastic/beats/pull/53857) | Apply the dns processor success_cache and failure_cache settings that were ignored since 8.11, and stop the success cache following failure_cache.enabled | 🔵 Review |
| OpenListTeam/OpenList | [#3209](https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList/pull/3209) | Fix `/api/fs/list` returning `provider: "unknown"` for every storage since #1532 moved the storage lookup under the write permission check: `FsList` in `server/handles/fsread.go` now looks the storage up for every list request, so `provider` carries the storage driver name again, while the direct upload tools stay limited to users who can write content at the path | 🔵 Review |
| 0xERR0R/blocky | [#2311](https://github.com/0xERR0R/blocky/pull/2311) | Fix DNSSEC validation returning SERVFAIL for wildcard answers reached through a CNAME: `validateWildcardProof` in `resolver/dnssec/wildcard.go` now checks the NSEC/NSEC3 proof against the expanded owner name (the CNAME target) instead of the original query name, so `www.vice.com` pointing to `savageplatform.go-vip.net` (served from `*.go-vip.net`) validates instead of being marked Bogus | 🔵 Review |
| 99designs/gqlgen | [#4389](https://github.com/99designs/gqlgen/pull/4389) | Fix `CollectFields` returning a field twice when a query selects it through two interfaces the same object implements, as in `posts { awards { id name } ... on PostInterface2 { awards { __typename } } }`: the collector now merges same-key entries whose definitions are both interfaces the resolved object satisfies, so the response keeps every requested subfield instead of only the selection set written last | 🔵 Review |
| ipfs/kubo | [#11478](https://github.com/ipfs/kubo/pull/11478) | Fix `ipfs add --nocopy` silently copying data into the blockstore after `Experimental.FilestoreEnabled` or `Experimental.UrlstoreEnabled` is turned on with `ipfs config` while the daemon runs: `add` now errors and asks for a daemon restart when the repo has no FileManager, so a `--nocopy` add the running node cannot honor fails loudly instead of duplicating the file into the blockstore | 🔵 Review |
| HyNetworks/hysteria | [#1704](https://github.com/HyNetworks/hysteria/pull/1704) | Fix ACL rules rejecting hyphenated outbound names: the rule line regex in `extras/outbounds/acl/parse.go` now accepts `[\w-]+` instead of `\w+` as the outbound name, so a rule like `New-turkey(geosite:cn)` that names an outbound the server config already accepts no longer fails with "invalid syntax" | 🔵 Review |
| yorukot/superfile | [#1685](https://github.com/yorukot/superfile/pull/1685) | Stop file operation hotkeys from acting on the file panel while another panel has focus: paste, new-file, extract and compress in `mainKey` now run only when the file panel is focused, matching copy, cut, delete and rename, so Ctrl+V with the sidebar focused no longer pastes into the file panel | 🔵 Review |
| argoproj/argo-cd | [#30188](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/30188) | Prevent cluster cache lock starvation on unwatchable APIService events by ignoring unchanged Available conditions, stopping retries immediately when groups have no watchable kinds, and coalescing concurrent reconciles | 🔵 Review |
| hashicorp/packer | [#13723](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13723) | Use overridden source name for packer_build_name in builders, provisioners and post-processors | 🔵 Review |

| wailsapp/wails | [#6251](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6251) | Stop the v2 macOS Open and Save file dialogs from aborting with NSInvalidArgumentException when a filter pattern such as `*.tar.gz` or `busted.exe` does not resolve to a UTType: an unresolved extension now falls back to its last component or is skipped, so the dialog opens instead of crashing the app | 🔵 Review |
| eksctl-io/eksctl | [#8901](https://github.com/eksctl-io/eksctl/pull/8901) | Stop config files from silently dropping keys written with the wrong case, such as `capacityReservationId` or `NodeGroups`: `ParseConfig` now decodes with apimachinery's strict deserializer, which matches keys case-sensitively and rejects unknown and duplicate keys in one pass, replacing a `sigs.k8s.io/yaml` pre-check whose encoding/json step ignored case | 🔵 Review |
| go-git/go-git | [#2522](https://github.com/go-git/go-git/pull/2522) | Stop `Log` with `All` and `LogOrderCommitterTime` from ordering commits only within each reference, by seeding one committer-time heap with HEAD and every reference tip the way `git log --all` does, so commits from orphan and side branches interleave by date instead of trailing behind as whole blocks | 🔵 Review |
| allegro/bigcache | [#441](https://github.com/allegro/bigcache/pull/441) | Stop the first `Get` from panicking with "unaligned 64-bit atomic operation" on 386, arm and 32-bit mips by moving the shard counters into private `atomic.Int64` fields behind an unchanged public `Stats`, resetting them per field with `Store(0)` to fix a data race with `hit()`, and adding a `GOARCH=386 go test` CI step | 🔵 Review |
| smallstep/certificates | [#2819](https://github.com/smallstep/certificates/pull/2819) | Stop one orders list request from breaking every later ACME order for the account: once no order is pending, `updateAddOrderIDs` now saves the orders index as `[]` instead of nil, which MySQL and PostgreSQL stored as NULL and Badger and bbolt as an empty value, and an empty value already on disk is read as an empty list so the account recovers | 🔵 Review |
| ThreeDotsLabs/watermill | [#701](https://github.com/ThreeDotsLabs/watermill/pull/701) | Stop slog's `AddSource` from pointing every Watermill log record at the adapter's own line in `slog.go`: `SlogLoggerAdapter` now captures its caller's PC with `runtime.Callers` and hands a `slog.NewRecord` straight to the handler, the pattern the log/slog docs give for wrappers, so the `source` field shows the real call site | 🔵 Review |
| Jguer/yay | [#2991](https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2991) | Stop `yay -Syu` from warning about missing AUR debug packages for split packages: `CalculateMissing` now also matches a `<x>-debug` package against the pkgbase of the installed AUR packages, so `immich-debug` next to `immich-cli` (pkgbase `immich`) is no longer reported | 🔵 Review |
| v2fly/v2ray-core | [#3840](https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3840) | Stop the v2jsonpb config loader from panicking on an unknown field name: its field lookups now return nil instead of an empty wrapper, so protojson reports the field as unknown, a stdin config such as `{"status": {}}` falls through to the next loader instead of crashing, and proto field names like `receiver_settings` are accepted | 🔵 Review |
| harness/harness | [#3729](https://github.com/harness/harness/pull/3729) | Reject devcontainer feature tar entries that escape the extraction directory (`../x`, `nested/../../x`, absolute paths) before the gitspace extractor writes anything, so a feature tarball can no longer write files outside it (path traversal) | 🔵 Review |
| fyne-io/fyne | [#6576](https://github.com/fyne-io/fyne/pull/6576) | Stop a multiline `Entry` from scrolling back to its cursor when it gains or loses focus, so scrolling away and clicking elsewhere keeps the scroll position and a click or tap into a scrolled, unfocused entry places the cursor where it lands | 🔵 Review |
| argoproj-labs/argocd-image-updater | [#1853](https://github.com/argoproj-labs/argocd-image-updater/pull/1853) | Keep a Docker Hub image's explicit `docker.io/library/` prefix on write-back instead of shortening it to `docker.io/<name>`, so kustomize matches the manifest again and constrained refs like `docker.io/library/nginx:~1.0` match their live image | 🔵 Review |
| abiosoft/colima | [#1645](https://github.com/abiosoft/colima/pull/1645) | Make `colima restart` prepare its config the same way as `colima start`, so a partial read-only colima.yaml under `COLIMA_SAVE_CONFIG=0` no longer restarts the VM with a 0 GiB root disk and leaves it stopped | 🔵 Review |
| asdf-vm/asdf | [#2340](https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf/pull/2340) | Skip `system` and `path:` versions in a bare `asdf install` instead of exiting 1, and keep installing the versions listed after them, so a `.tool-versions` entry like `postgres system` no longer fails the whole install | 🔵 Review |
| kedacore/keda | [#8254](https://github.com/kedacore/keda/pull/8254) | Read the Azure Workload Identity client id from the scale target's service account annotation when `identityOwner: workload` is set, as aws already does, so a TriggerAuthentication no longer has to repeat each workload's `identityId` | 🔵 Review |
| kedacore/keda-docs | [#1894](https://github.com/kedacore/keda-docs/pull/1894) | Document Azure Workload Identity's `identityOwner: workload`, which takes the client id from the scale target's service account, still needs a federated credential for the KEDA operator and cannot be combined with `identityId` | 🔵 Review |
| pulumi/pulumi | [#24995](https://github.com/pulumi/pulumi/pull/24995) | Redact secret values as `[secret]` in invalid input diagnostics unless `--show-secrets` is passed, so a provider Check failure, the `pulumi import` warning or a Construct or Call input error no longer prints them in plaintext | 🔵 Review |
| wailsapp/wails | [#6212](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6212) | Mark dependencies that only the local check finds as installed in the v2 `wails doctor` on Linux, so npm is no longer reported missing when the package manager does not list it, for example in a container image with the apt lists removed | 🔵 Review |
| goss-org/goss | [#1136](https://github.com/goss-org/goss/pull/1136) | Stop a `not` around an `or` from panicking when no child matched, so a missing gjson path or an erroring child such as `have-key` against a string reports the failure instead of crashing goss | 🔵 Review |
| hashicorp/packer | [#13716](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13716) | Keep `PACKER_GITHUB_API_TOKEN` on redirected requests, so installing a plugin whose GitHub repository was renamed or transferred no longer falls back to the anonymous rate limit and blocks the plugins installed after it | 🔵 Review |
| git-lfs/git-lfs | [#6356](https://github.com/git-lfs/git-lfs/pull/6356) | Pass `<transport>://<address>` remote helper URLs through unchanged, as Git does, instead of misreading them as SSH endpoints for a host named after the transport | 🔵 Review |
| trufflesecurity/trufflehog | [#5378](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5378) | Strip the calling hook's repo-local Git variables from the `git clone` TruffleHog runs, so a pre-commit hook running `trufflehog git file://.` no longer turns `git commit -a` into an empty commit | 🔵 Review |
| go-gitea/gitea | [#39519](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/39519) | Stable repo list pagination with an id tiebreaker | 🔵 Review |
| tailscale/tailscale | [#21526](https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/pull/21526) | Reject a `tailscale set --relay-server-port` value that magicsock is already bound to, so the edit fails with an error instead of leaving a peer relay that silently never starts | 🔵 Review |
| getsops/sops | [#2305](https://github.com/getsops/sops/pull/2305) | Skip files that match no destination rule in `sops publish --recursive` instead of aborting the walk, and give empty or invalid destination rules their own error | 🔵 Review |
| grafana/loki | [#24775](https://github.com/grafana/loki/pull/24775) | Stop counting a compaction run canceled by shutdown or compactor handover as a failure in the compaction and retention operation metrics | 🔵 Review |
| prometheus-community/helm-charts | [#7310](https://github.com/prometheus-community/helm-charts/pull/7310) | Point the couchdb-exporter probes at /status, since image v28 answers / with 404 and the pod never became ready | 🔵 Review |
| kubernetes-sigs/kustomize | [#6287](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/pull/6287) | Stop `kustomize edit` from duplicating `#` lines inside YAML block scalars by tracking block scalar indentation | 🔵 Review |
| zalando/postgres-operator | [#3189](https://github.com/zalando/postgres-operator/pull/3189) | Delete cluster services with background propagation so the replica service's EndpointSlices are not orphaned | 🔵 Review |
| istio/istio | [#61851](https://github.com/istio/istio/pull/61851) | Honor verifyCertificateHash and verifyCertificateSpki on file-mounted Gateway and Sidecar server certs | 🔵 Review |
| antrea-io/antrea | [#8436](https://github.com/antrea-io/antrea/pull/8436) | Escape user-supplied L7 NetworkPolicy `host` / `path` / `sni` patterns in generated Suricata rules, so a quote or semicolon can no longer close `content:` early and inject extra rule keywords | 🔵 Review |
| mariadb-operator/mariadb-operator | [#1907](https://github.com/mariadb-operator/mariadb-operator/pull/1907) | Enforce the PhysicalBackup `timeout` through the Job's `activeDeadlineSeconds` so timed out backups are reported as failed instead of `Success`, and never bootstrap replicas from a failed backup | 🔵 Review |
